1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein __said fins are integrally formed with said columnar body and extend radially outward therefrom__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board with AC to DC conversion circuitry__.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and said diodes are mounted on planar surfaces of said columnar body__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has substantially straight side walls__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein __exactly one diode resides on each face of said columnar body__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and said fins are substantially equally spaced between said diodes__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material is selected from copper or aluminum alloys__.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base __configured for direct insertion into a standard light socket__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, __exactly one light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body__, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __said electronics module including AC to DC conversion circuitry__, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __with integral radially extending fins__, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching __exactly one light emitting diode to each side of__ said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode __including AC to DC conversion capability__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and is selected from aluminum alloys__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __substantially equally spaced around said body__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and polygonal cross-section__.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, wherein said optic element is positioned to preferentially direct light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __selected to convert LED wavelengths to visible light__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 __further including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin, each optic element overlapping a respective diode and including a phosphor material__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and includes a phosphor material for wavelength conversion__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and is configured to regulate power delivery to said light emitting diodes__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and said fins and diodes are configured to provide both thermal dissipation and light transmission over the lamp outer surface__.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein __exactly one diode resides on each face and said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body__.
